decls.name: SublemmaLinearDisjointFromDisjointRamification

paper_span.quote: Since the ramified rational primes are disjoint, the \(L_i\)'s are linearly disjoint, giving

decls.rationale: The linear-disjointness half of Proposition 3.2(1): the \(L_i\) ramify at pairwise distinct primes \(r_i\), hence are linearly disjoint over \(\mathbb{Q}\).
